issues.description: The template implementation of create_controlled_single_qubit_gate in dd_simulation.py declares the parameter order as (num_qubits, target, control, gate_matrix), which conflicts with the problem description and the solution implementation that use (num_qubits, control, target, gate_matrix). This mismatch will confuse students (docstrings and examples refer to control then target) and cause signatures to differ from the reference solution and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template function signature to match the intended ordering (num_qubits, control, target, gate_matrix) and update any in-file references/docs accordingly, so students see a consistent API that matches the problem description and the solution.
